name: allterrain-media-explorer
description: The media library WordPress should have shipped, as an OpenStation desktop app.

scripts.build: npm run build:bundles && npm run deploy
scripts.build:bundles: npm run build:explorer && npm run build:shell && npm run build:codec
scripts.build:explorer: ATME_TARGET=explorer vite build --mode development && ATME_TARGET=explorer vite build --mode production
scripts.build:shell: ATME_TARGET=shell vite build --mode development && ATME_TARGET=shell vite build --mode production
scripts.build:codec: ATME_TARGET=codec vite build --mode development && ATME_TARGET=codec vite build --mode production
scripts.plugin:build: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build:bundles
scripts.plugin:release: npm run plugin:build && npm run test:php && npm run plugin:check && node bin/package.mjs
